policy: Every requirement is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the page named in source_roles. Nothing is inferred.
structure_note: A group of settlement titles rather than one route, including the artist settlement permit and permits for people already resident. Two distinct thresholds appear: A1 German when first applying for a settlement permit excluding gainful employment, and five years' uninterrupted entitlement to reside for another title.
freshness_note: No dateline is published and the body mentions no year. Tracked by check-source-freshness as '[none published]', the same condition as sources already live in this registry.
not_extracted: The institution list for acceptable German diplomas, which the page introduces and then enumerates as a list of providers rather than a requirement.

requirements.label: Health insurance covering all risks, with benefits in Austria
requirements.description: The same standard as family reunification.
requirements.source_excerpt: the third-country national must have health insurance coverage, providing benefits in austria and covering all risks.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The third-country national must have health insurance coverage, providing benefits in Austria and covering all risks.

requirements.label: Accommodation adequate for the family size by local standards
requirements.description: Assessed against family size, not the applicant alone.
requirements.source_excerpt: the third-country national must provide evidence of a legal title to an accommodation (e.g. by presenting a lease contract) considered adequate for his/her family size according to local standards.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The third-country national must provide evidence of a legal title to an accommodation (e.g. by presenting a lease contract) considered adequate for his/her family size according to local standards.

requirements.label: German at A1 for a settlement permit excluding gainful employment
requirements.description: The authority is explicit that only beginner-level German is required for this title.
requirements.source_excerpt: third-country nationals have to provide evidence of german language skills at a1 level according to the common european framework of reference for languages , when first applying for a residence title “settlement permit – gainful employment excluded”. only basic german language skills at beginner level are required.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Third-country nationals have to provide evidence of German language skills at A1 level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages, when first applying for a residence title “Settlement permit – gainful employment excluded”. Only basic German language skills at beginner level are required.

requirements.label: Five years' uninterrupted entitlement to reside
requirements.description: A separate threshold for a different title in this group — not an alternative to the A1 requirement above.
requirements.source_excerpt: have been entitled to reside in austria during the last five years without interruption,
requirements.source_excerpt_display: have been entitled to reside in Austria during the last five years without interruption,

requirements.label: Proof of artistic education, or a description of former works
requirements.description: For the artist settlement permit, the authority accepts a description of past work in place of formal education.
requirements.source_excerpt: proof of an artistic education or description of former artistic works
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Proof of an artistic education or description of former artistic works
